changelog:
-Integrated Hermes Agent Upstream Tracking System: Automatically synchronizes and evaluates changes in core modules.
-Smart Upstream Management: Supports automatic detection, analysis, and merging of critical updates from the upstream Hermes Agent.
-Enhanced CLI: Added evo upstream commands (check, status, diff, list, fuse) for one-click tracking and integration.
-Automated Logging & Alerts: Tracking results and high-value changes are automatically recorded, -supporting evaluation and notifications.
-Comprehensive Documentation Updates: Includes new development and synchronization guidelines.
